name: Large Professor
hook: A producer who learned the SP-1200 from Paul C, taught Q-Tip, discovered Nas, and turns up in the credits all over early-90s New York.

blurb.age7: A producer from Queens who taught other famous producers and found the rapper Nas.
blurb.age13: William Mitchell, known as Large Professor, learned to use the SP-1200 from Paul C, an engineer and producer who was killed in 1989. With his group Main Source he made the album Breaking Atoms in 1991, and on one song he gave a verse to a seventeen-year-old called Nas. He helped Q-Tip of A Tribe Called Quest learn the SP-1200 and another sampler, the Akai S950, and later produced three songs on Nas's first album.
blurb.adult: Large Professor is a producers' producer: the teacher in several of the lineages on this map. His own teacher, Paul C (Paul McKasty), engineered and co-produced records for Ultramagnetic MCs and others before his murder in 1989, and is not on the map yet. Large Professor's reach runs through Q-Tip's equipment, Nas's career and his own Main Source records.
